title: Sinusoidal development scenes, 240-output rollouts
description: The eight development scenes of sinusoidal-v1 (four grid shapes at 8 and 16 cells per metre), each rolled out on its own outputs for 240 output intervals (4 s) from rest. Each subject starts from a case's first recorded state and is fed its own outputs from then on; every output is scored against the recording and the first pass is timed after warm-up. The cases have already informed model choices (population: consumed), so a score here is not evidence of generalisation. The suite and metrics are defined in surrogate/bench/suites.py and surrogate/bench/metrics.py.
